svg.title: Mano: one item or one phase, one learning loop at a time
svg.desc: A living backlog is updated through import, start, review, mano task, and direct human edits. It feeds two learning loops that both return to it. The inner loop is mano task: one item is written down with the human's own check before any code, built on its own, and tried; the human answers works, broken, or different, and the item closes or returns to the backlog in their words. The outer loop is mano start: the human approves one small phase, only the planning artifacts it needs are added (spec, ux, rules, ui: created, reused, or brought in), and implementation forks into two ways in, decided by the ledger: mano stories writes a stories ledger that mano dev implements, or mano build works straight from the approved brief through progress.md. Auto mode stops before review. The human uses the result and runs mano review, which is required and closes the phase; learning updates the backlog. Optional owner mode supports parallel phase tracks over a shared backlog; it is routing only, so teams use branches or worktrees for isolation.
svg.text: A fast planning loop for AI-assisted development
You decide why, what, and how.
Mano helps plan and review one learning loop at a time.
